### Execution Summary: Work Order 4 — Index Migration

All requirements for **Work Order 4 (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo4`)** have been verified and validated.

#### 1. Schema Migration (`internal/core/index/index.go`)
- Preserved existing `episodes_fts`, `entities`, and `entity_relations` tables for backward compatibility.
- Added v2 tables and virtual tables with trigger synchronisation:
  - `entries` table (`id`, `type`, `dossier_scope`, `text`, `source`, `verified`, `closes_when`, `created_at`, `updated_at`).
  - `entries_fts` (FTS5 over `entries` using `content=entries, content_rowid=rowid`) with `entries_ai`, `entries_ad`, and `entries_au` triggers.
  - `entry_anchors` table (`entry_id`, `anchor`, `kind`, `fingerprint`) with index `idx_entry_anchors_anchor`.
  - `error_patterns` table (`entry_id`, `command_prefix`, `pattern`, `dossier_scope`).
  - `aliases` table (`old_scope`, `new_scope`, `created_at`).
  - `entry_history` table (`id`, `entry_id`, `type`, `dossier_scope`, `text`, `reason`, `superseded_by`, `retired_at`).

#### 2. Entry CRUD (`internal/core/index/entries.go`)
- [`UpsertEntry`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L38-L96): Upserts into `entries` and syncs anchors.
- [`GetEntry`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L99-L141): Retrieves entry by ID, populating anchors; returns `ErrNotFound` on missing records.
- [`DeleteEntry`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L144-L157): Deletes entry, anchors, error patterns, and triggers FTS removal.
- [`ListEntriesByScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L160-L215): Returns entries for a scope ordered by ID.
- [`SearchEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L218-L279): Executes FTS5 search ordered by BM25 relevance.

#### 3. Anchor Lookups (`internal/core/index/entry_anchors.go`)
- [`UpsertEntryAnchors`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entry_anchors.go#L11-L40): Atomically replaces all anchors for an entry.
- [`LookupByAnchor`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entry_anchors.go#L43-L70): Prefix lookup using `LIKE 'anchor%'`.
- [`LookupByAnchorExact`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entry_anchors.go#L73-L95): Exact anchor matching.

#### 4. Error Patterns (`internal/core/index/entries.go`)
- [`InsertErrorPattern`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L290-L297): Associates failure signature entries with command prefix and pattern.
- [`LookupErrorPatterns`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L300-L336): Matches candidate commands against stored prefixes, ordered by specificity.

#### 5. Aliases (`internal/core/index/entries.go`)
- [`UpsertAlias`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L339-L352): Records or updates scope redirection.
- [`ResolveAlias`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L355-L383): Follows alias chains up to depth 10 with cycle detection.

#### 6. History (`internal/core/index/entries.go`)
- [`InsertHistory`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L386-L415): Stores retired or superseded entries with reason and timestamp.
- [`GetHistory`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L418-L450): Retrieves retired records ordered by `retired_at DESC`.

#### 7. Rebuild from Op Log (`internal/core/index/rebuild.go`)
- [`RebuildFromOpLog`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/rebuild.go#L15-L129): Projects dossiers from [`ops.Reader`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/reader.go), clears v2 tables in a transaction, writes entries/anchors/patterns/history, and populates aliases from [`config.BuildAliasMap`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go).
